1use crate::third_party::lopdf::{Dictionary, Document, Object, ObjectId, Result};
2
3#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
4pub struct IncrementalDocument {
5    /// The raw data for the files read from input.
6    bytes_documents: Vec<u8>,
7
8    /// The combined result of `bytes_documents`.
9    /// Do not edit this document as it will not be saved.
10    prev_documents: Document,
11
12    /// A new document appended to the previously loaded file.
13    pub new_document: Document,
14}
15
16impl IncrementalDocument {
17    /// Create new PDF document.
18    pub fn new() -> Self {
19        Self { bytes_documents: Vec::new(), prev_documents: Document::new(), new_document: Document::new() }
20    }
21
22    /// Create new `IncrementalDocument` from the bytes and document.
23    ///
24    /// The function expects the bytes and previous document to match.
25    /// If they do not match exactly this might result in broken PDFs.
26    pub fn create_from(prev_bytes: Vec<u8>, prev_documents: Document) -> Self {
27        Self { bytes_documents: prev_bytes, new_document: Document::new_from_prev(&prev_documents), prev_documents }
28    }
29
30    /// Get the structure of the previous documents (all prev incremental updates combined.)
31    pub fn get_prev_documents(&self) -> &Document {
32        &self.prev_documents
33    }
34
35    /// Get the bytes of the previous documents.
36    pub fn get_prev_documents_bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
37        &self.bytes_documents
38    }
39
40    /// Clone Object from previous document to new document.
41    /// If the object already exists nothing is done.
42    ///
43    /// This function can be used to clone an object so it can be changed in the incremental updates.
44    pub fn opt_clone_object_to_new_document(&mut self, object_id: ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
45        if !self.new_document.has_object(object_id) {
46            let old_object = self.prev_documents.get_object(object_id)?;
47            self.new_document.set_object(object_id, old_object.clone());
48        }
49        Ok(())
50    }
51
52    /// Get the page's resource dictionary (only in new document).
53    ///
54    /// Get Object that has the key `Resources`.
55    pub fn get_or_create_resources(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Result<&mut Object> {
56        self.opt_clone_object_to_new_document(page_id)?;
57        let resources_id = {
58            let page = self.new_document.get_object(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict)?;
59            if page.has(b"Resources") { page.get(b"Resources").and_then(Object::as_reference).ok() } else { None }
60        };
61        if let Some(res_id) = resources_id {
62            self.opt_clone_object_to_new_document(res_id)?;
63            return self.new_document.get_object_mut(res_id);
64        }
65        let page = self.new_document.get_object_mut(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut)?;
66        if !page.has(b"Resources") {
67            page.set(b"Resources", Dictionary::new());
68        }
69        page.get_mut(b"Resources")
70    }
71
72    /// Add XObject to a page.
73    ///
74    /// Get Object that has the key `Resources -> XObject`.
75    pub fn add_xobject<N: Into<Vec<u8>>>(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId, xobject_name: N, xobject_id: ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
76        if let Ok(resources) = self.get_or_create_resources(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut) {
77            if !resources.has(b"XObject") {
78                resources.set("XObject", Dictionary::new());
79            }
80            let mut xobjects = resources.get_mut(b"XObject")?;
81            if let Object::Reference(xobjects_ref_id) = xobjects {
82                let mut xobjects_id = *xobjects_ref_id;
83                while let Object::Reference(id) = self.new_document.get_object(xobjects_id)? {
84                    xobjects_id = *id;
85                }
86                xobjects = self.new_document.get_object_mut(xobjects_id)?;
87            }
88            let xobjects = Object::as_dict_mut(xobjects)?;
89            xobjects.set(xobject_name, Object::Reference(xobject_id));
90        }
91        Ok(())
92    }
93
94    /// Add Graphics State to a page.
95    ///
96    /// Get Object that has the key `Resources -> ExtGState`.
97    pub fn add_graphics_state<N: Into<Vec<u8>>>(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId, gs_name: N, gs_id: ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
98        if let Ok(resources) = self.get_or_create_resources(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut) {
99            if !resources.has(b"ExtGState") {
100                resources.set("ExtGState", Dictionary::new());
101            }
102            let states = resources.get_mut(b"ExtGState").and_then(Object::as_dict_mut)?;
103            states.set(gs_name, Object::Reference(gs_id));
104        }
105        Ok(())
106    }
107}
108
109impl Default for IncrementalDocument {
110    fn default() -> Self {
111        Self::new()
112    }
113}
